يستنطقون (form X)
# يَسْتَنْطِقُونَ (yastanṭiqūna) /jas.tan.tˤi.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# يُسْتَنْطَقُونَ (yustanṭaqūna) /jus.tan.tˤa.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
